answer: The bridge cap is checked at intake and oasis reveals the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 3 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a umber tag. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
